$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Enforced by scripts/audit.ts (`bun run audit`), which
fails CI on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here, on any entry past its reviewBy
date, on any entry no longer present in the graph, and on any `no-fix-available` entry
that upstream has since fixed — including a fix published under a renamed package.
This replaced a bare `bun audit --ignore=GHSA-...` flag, which had no exit condition and
spent two months suppressing an advisory that had already been fixed upstream.
no-fix-available  upstream has published no fixed release. Re-verified against the
GitHub advisory API on every run and fails the moment one appears,
including a fix shipped under a renamed successor package.
backlog           a fix exists; the upgrade is queued. Bounded by reviewBy.
not-exploitable   only reachable through a code path this repo does not use.
pinned            the vulnerable version is deliberately pinned and the pin is load-bearing.
